llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The change from value type to pointer type in corev1.ServiceSpec.Type will break any code performing direct equality comparisons like svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer. This affects multiple repositories including Helm charts, ArgoCD, ingress-nginx, external-dns, and Prometheus, requiring updates to handle pointer dereferencing or nil checks.

FILES:
- helm/charts/ingress-nginx/templates/controller-service.yaml — Direct comparison of svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer
- helm/charts/external-dns/templates/service.yaml — Direct comparison of svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer
- argo-cd/manifests/ha/redis-ha/servicemonitor.yaml — Direct comparison of svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer
- ingress-nginx/internal/ingress/controller/service.go — Direct comparison of svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer
- external-dns/source/service.go — Direct comparison of svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer
- prometheus-community/helm-charts/kube-prometheus-stack/templates/prometheus/service.yaml — Direct comparison of svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer
- prometheus-community/helm-charts/kube-prometheus-stack/templates/alertmanager/service.yaml — Direct comparison of svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer
- prometheus-community/helm-charts/kube-prometheus-stack/templates/grafana/service.yaml — Direct comparison of svc.Spec.Type == corev1.ServiceTypeLoadBalancer
